summary: Full backend + frontend testing for the CMS-editable Services feature. All 7 pytest cases passed (public list/detail/404, admin login, admin list, full CRUD round-trip with rich fields, legacy backward-compat). Frontend e2e via Playwright: services grid renders 6 dynamic cards, detail page renders sub_services (2), FAQ (1), CTA title/text/button, sidebar links, dynamic footer services, quote modal opens. Admin login works, /admin/services shows 6 edit buttons + Nouveau service; all 8 tabs (info/content/features/sub/gallery/faq/cta/seo) present. End-to-end edit flow verified: changed CTA title in admin CTA tab -> saved -> reflected on /services/etudes-fondations. CTA restored after test.

issues: Console warning: DialogContent missing DialogTitle / aria-describedby (accessibility a11y)
Recharts warning: container width/height = -1 (chart parent has no dimensions on first render)

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Wrap QuoteModal DialogContent with a hidden DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden) to fix Radix a11y warning.
(Optional/low priority) Ensure admin dashboard chart containers have min-height so Recharts doesn't warn about -1 dimensions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1150+ lines — consider splitting into routers (services.py, admin.py, public.py) for maintainability (>700 lines threshold).

PATCH /api/admin/services/{sid} accepts a full ServiceCreate payload (not a partial). If an admin sends a partial payload missing required fields (title/short/description/slug), it will 422. Consider a ServiceUpdate model with all Optional fields.

DELETE /api/admin/services depends on `require_admin` (admin or super_admin), NOT super_admin only — review request stated 'requires super_admin'; actual behaviour is admin-and-above. This is fine but inconsistent with request wording.

ServiceDetail.jsx imports `process as steps` from mock (fine) but sub_services icon mapping is hardcoded to a small subset; unknown icons silently fall back to FileText — could add a fallback badge for editors.
No unique-index on services.slug in Mongo — two services could be created with the same slug via admin, causing shadowing on public/{slug}. Add a unique index or explicit check.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. During testing created 2 TEST_ services (rich + legacy) and deleted them. Temporarily changed CTA title on etudes-fondations then restored to 'Prêt à lancer votre projet ?'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Services CRUD with rich fields is solid. Public /api/public/services returns 6 seeded items with slugs: etudes-fondations, suivi-controle, renovation, vrd-travaux-publics, plans-2d-3d, conseil-technique. Admin tabbed form works end-to-end. Note: the review request referenced 'construction-modern' slug as example but actual seeded slugs are the 6 above — no bug, just naming in request was illustrative.
